overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on creating a challenging commonsense reasoning dataset (DISCOSENSE) using NLG methods for distractor generation. The NLG evaluation aspects are mainly part of the dataset construction process rather than comprehensive NLG system evaluation. The main NLG contributions are in the Conditional Adversarial Filtering approach for generating challenging distractors.
